body: v0.10.47 cut (2026-09-24 16:09 EDT, Mac orchestrator hall9k-a7) on 630aa2481, the merge of hall9k#582 (a50ce8e3: an install or update under a redirected HALL9K_HOME leaves the real h9k PATH link alone and prints a skip line naming <home>/bin instead; bootstrap scripts and docs carry the same). Release run 36052718678 green on all four builds; gh release view v0.10.47 shows FIVE assets (checksums.txt plus linux-x64, osx-arm64, win-arm64, win-x64). No schema change, so a plain 'h9k update --restart' at your lull is enough; please report the install as usual. Lesson 5082d6bc's first clause (snapshot and restore the Windows user PATH around a scratch run) is superseded by this fix; its second clause stands.
